content_sections.text: Age relaxation, Consultant: Retired faculty member Not more than 70 yrs, Others As per GoI norms. Age relaxation, Junior Project Fellow (JPF): All As per GoI Norms. faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for NCERT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 11 December 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCERT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Consultant, 1 Junior Project Fellow (JPF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NCERT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 11 December 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Consultant: not more than 45 yrs; in case of retired faculty member not more than 70 yrs; Junior Project Fellow (JPF): below 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 80,000 - 1,00,000 per month (To be decided by competent authority based on recommendation of the committee keeping in view experience & expertise of the candidate) for Consultant, Rs. 37,000 per month (NET/Ph.D.); Rs. 35,000 per month (Non-NET) for Junior Project Fellow (JPF).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consultant: Post Graduation Degree in Psychology/Social Work/Human Development/Education with qualifications as per UGC Guidelines for Assistant Professor at entry level, plus 3 years experience. JPF: Post Graduation in Psychology/Social Work/Human Development/Education with minimum 55% marks for General Category (50% for SC/ST/PH). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Experience in Research/Teaching/Training/Extension Activities/Content Development should be related to school education. Time spent pursuing MPhil and/or PhD does not count as teaching or research experience for eligibility. SC/ST/PH candidates eligible with minimum 50% marks in relevant master degree.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates appearing for the interview after 11.00 a.m. will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Registration 9.30 a.m. to 11.00 a.m. in G.B Pant Block, 5th floor, Room No. 518.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary, contractual posts for a period up to 31 March 2027. Under project Manodarpan approved by the PAB for the year 2026-27. Fellowship confers no claim for regular employment in NCERT.
